AXION Calc respects your privacy. This policy explains how the app handles information.
AXION Calc does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data to external servers. All calculations and preferences stay on your device.
The app only stores your language and theme preferences locally using Android DataStore. This data never leaves your device.

The app does not require or use internet access for its core functionality. Opening external links (GitHub, product pages, or email) is performed only when you explicitly tap a banner or the feedback button.
AXION Calc does not request any sensitive permissions. The optional default-calculator role uses the system RoleManager API and does not grant the app access to other data.
No analytics, advertising, crash-reporting, or third-party SDKs that transmit data are included.
The app is suitable for all ages and does not knowingly collect any information from children.
If this policy is updated, the new version will be included in a future app release. Continued use of the app after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
Questions about privacy can be sent via the in-app feedback option or to axionneuralis@gmail.com / azrielpace852@gmail.com.
